title: An Invariant Learning Characterization of Controlled Text Generation
findings: In an experimental setting where prompts included religious contexts (the Personification dataset), the proposed invariant learning methods (specifically V-REx with EVIAN-Metadata) demonstrated significantly improved and more stable performance in controlling for toxicity compared to a standard baseline (ERM), particularly when hyperparameters were tuned using an oracle with access to the deployment distribution.
